stories.title: Passkey Sign-In Gate, Step-Up Re-Verification & Owner Guard
stories.description: Re-groomed 2026-09-25 (split from the original 8-point hardening story; session management, alerts and browser hardening moved to STORY-118). Passkeys are optional, but once a user has one it is required at every sign-in, so a stolen Discord account alone cannot reach the dashboard. Removing a passkey needs a fresh passkey check. Sensitive writes (owner console, integrations, moderation escalation policy, reaction-role publishing) always need a passkey check newer than 5 minutes, so users without a passkey cannot perform them. Bot owners (BOT_OWNER_ID) must have a passkey. Recovery is an operator CLI reset, not recovery codes. Sessions stay opaque and server-side: JWE was re-evaluated and rejected again because a stolen token is replayed, not decrypted (ADR-013).

stories.title: Session Management, Sign-In & Change Alerts, Browser Hardening & Authorization Coverage

Risk-based re-checks on IP or user-agent changes were considered and dropped: an infostealer copies the device cookie together with the session cookie, and IP binding misfires for mobile and VPN users.

stories.title: Unified Configurable Reset Boundary & Consecutive-Miss Streak Forgiveness
stories.description: Replace the five independent UTC calendar-day resets with one shared configurable reset boundary (default 00:00 GMT+8), exposed through a core ResetSchedule helper returning an integer day index. Covers energy replenishment, the energy potion daily ceiling, TCG shop daily rotation, the economy shop daily purchase limit and /daily. Converts /daily from a rolling 24h cooldown with 12h grace into a calendar-day claim with consecutive-miss streak forgiveness: fewer consecutive missed days than the configured threshold preserve the streak (missed days are skipped, never counted), reaching the threshold wipes the streak and the triggering claim counts as day 1. Missed count is derived from lastDailyAt rather than persisted. One global timezone offset with per-feature clock-time overrides.

bugs.title: Fix Silent Audio Player Failure & Implement Real Multi-Source Extractors
bugs.description: Extractors previously returned mock stubs pushing null to Readable streams, causing silent player idle exits. Integrate real audio extraction & fallback streaming for YouTube, Spotify, SoundCloud, and Deezer.

bugs.title: Spotify Audio Mirroring Hard Artist Gate & Blind Fallback Elimination
bugs.description: Enforce strict hard artist filtering in PrecisionTrackMatcher and eliminate unconstrained SoundCloud title search fallback in YouTubeAdapter to prevent rogue club tracks from streaming.

bugs.title: OpenAI & LLM Providers Function Name Schema Validation & Sanitization
bugs.description: OpenAI API rejects tool function names containing dots (e.g. reminders.create) with 400 error matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$. Implement bi-directional tool name sanitization and alias resolution across OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, and ToolRegistry.

bugs.title: Unfulfilled Assistant Tool Calls in Historical Context Causing OpenAI 400 Error
bugs.description: OpenAI API throws 400 when an assistant message with tool_calls in conversation history is not followed by tool messages for each tool_call_id. Normalize message mapping in OpenAI, Gemini, and Ollama providers to ensure unresponded tool calls are not sent as pending requests.

bugs.title: Duplicate Tool Execution and Unrendered Raw JSON Tool Responses in AI Chat
bugs.description: Fix duplicate tool execution caused by stream/generate fallback condition when tools emit empty text. Feed tool execution results back to the LLM to synthesize natural language responses with clean fallback formatting.

bugs.title: Ignore Prefix Commands in AI Chat & Wire Real Database Values in EconomyBalanceTool
bugs.description: Ignore messages starting with bot command prefix in AI chat controller to prevent duplicate responses to prefix commands. Connect real database economy balance resolver to EconomyBalanceTool.

bugs.title: Wire Real Music Player Execution to MusicPlayTool in AI Chatbot
bugs.description: Connect MusicPlayTool in AI chat to real MusicPlayerService, validating voice channel presence and permissions, joining, queueing audio tracks, and refreshing the active music embed controller.

bugs.title: Fix Waifu TCG Tutorial False Completion, Missing Starter Card Seed & $climb Route
bugs.description: Fix false tutorial completion caused by immediate floor 4 completion and unseeded starter card foreign key error; seed starter_waifu_01; route incomplete players from $climb into tutorial floors; fix prefix climb alias argument resolution.

bugs.title: Fix Tutorial Floor T4 Defeat Counter Card Grant & Stale Metadata Recovery
bugs.description: Ensure handleTutorialFloor4Defeat validates active card ownership before treating counter card as already given; grant real common counter card if user does not possess one; clear tcg_system_configs during user reset.

bugs.title: Grant TCG Items by Catalog Code, Auto-Equip Starter Blade & Repair Legacy Item Rows
bugs.description: Tutorial, dungeon loot and achievement rewards insert fake item ids (item_novice_blade, potion_hp_minor, weap_*) that never match game_items UUIDs, so rewards are invisible. Add a shared code-based item grant used by shop, tutorial, loot and achievements; auto-equip Novice Blade on the starter card; remap legacy rows at boot.

bugs.title: Persist Crafting Dust and Charge It for Equipment Enhancement
bugs.description: Crafting dust from dismantling, expeditions, boss raids, dungeon loot and achievements is shown but never stored, and enhancement passes a hard-coded 5000 dust. Store dust as a stackable CRAFTING_DUST inventory item granted by every source and spent atomically by EnhancementService.

bugs.title: Equipped Gear Leaks Across Card Sales, Trades & Dismantles; Add Unequip All
bugs.description: Selling, trading or dismantling a card never unequips its gear. The buyer's card fights with the seller's gear (findEquippedByCard ignores owner), while the seller's gear stays EQUIPPED on a card they no longer own and cannot be recovered without an item ID no screen shows. Fix: only empty cards can be listed, bought, traded or accepted (clear error naming the equipped slots and how to unequip); gear cannot be equipped onto IN_TRADE/IN_MARKET cards; dismantle returns gear to the inventory; card loadouts only count gear owned by the card's owner; new unequip-all (one card or every card, which also recovers stranded gear) via /card action:unequip-all and an Unequip All button in /loadout.

bugs.title: player_energy.bonus_energy Is Read as Capacity but Never Granted (Daily Incremental Bonus Energy & Configurable Admin Cap)
bugs.description: Daily incremental bonus energy accumulation up to an admin-configurable cap. Reconciles on daily reset rollover in EnergyLifecycleService, replenishing current energy up to maxEnergy + bonusEnergy. Configured via /tcg-admin action:energy with bonus_cap and bonus_increment parameters.

bugs.title: Daily Energy Replenishment Never Fires: EnergyLifecycleService Is Unwired
bugs.description: EnergyLifecycleService.getOrReconcileUserEnergy and replenishUserEnergy had no callers anywhere in apps/ or packages/, so player energy was never replenished and max energy never scaled with player level. Players spent their starting 100 energy and could never recover it except through the 3/day potion ceiling. Fixed by making EnergyLifecycleService the gateway for every energy debit (spendEnergy, consumePotion, refundEnergy), wiring it into expeditions, dungeon runs, boss raids, PvP duels and both potion paths, and giving it an XP-backed level resolver so capacity scales without callers passing a level. Note: the half-energy refund on dungeon floors 1-10 was already implemented in DungeonProgressService and correctly wired; the original report was wrong on that point.

bugs.title: Catalog Seed Is Insert-Only, So Item Copy and Stat Changes Never Reach Existing DBs
bugs.description: Catalog seed in services.ts previously only inserted non-existent items. Update boot-time canonical item seeding to upsert catalog-owned attributes (name, description, type, subtype, rarity, baseStats, battlePerks, consumableEffect, isShopBuyable, shopPrice, maxDailyPurchases, isTradeable) while preserving existing item IDs, ensuring game balance and text fixes reach existing databases.

bugs.title: Gear, Craft and Shop Dropdowns Silently Drop Entries Past 25
bugs.description: Discord select menus hold at most 25 options. Add pagination or chunking (and a visible 'showing X-Y of N' indicator) with Prev/Next controls in gear-menu, craft-menu and shop-menu where item or card collections can exceed 25 options.

bugs.title: Persist and Restore Guild Default Volume Across Music Sessions
bugs.description: Wire guild default volume resolution into MusicPlayerService and LavalinkService so that volume set via $volume or /volume is restored on new playback sessions instead of reverting to 80%, implement setVolume on LavalinkQueueAdapter, and display the guild default volume when /volume is run with no arguments while idle.

bugs.title: Unknown /card Prefix Action Silently Opens the Collection & Card ID / Serial Number Overhaul
bugs.description: Fix unrecognized !card prefix action silently opening collection by computing Did-You-Mean suggestions and error replies. Auto-route card identifiers (!card 1, !card Harribel) to inspect. Add flexible card resolution (UUID, 8-char short ID, 1-based index, character name, serial) across inspect, favorite, equip, dismantle, gear, and loadout. Disambiguate card ID from character collection number and mint serial counter.

bugs.title: Fix Replicate Provider Timeout from Prefer: wait Header and Discord WebP Attachment Extension
bugs.description: Remove hanging Prefer: wait header in Replicate prediction creation and use fast asynchronous creation + status polling. Direct fetch image buffer downloads without API rate limiter. Fix Discord attachment extension dynamically mapping WebP and JPEG mime types so Discord embed previews render correctly.

bugs.title: Passkey Sign-In Check Rejected Authenticators Without the User-Verification Flag; Failures Were Unlogged and Escaped as Unhandled Errors
bugs.description: Reported 2026-09-25: the passkey check failed with 'The passkey could not be verified' in Edge while registration worked. Root cause: the authenticator Edge used signed assertions without the user-verification (UV) flag, and verification required it. The reason was invisible because verification failures were not logged. Two more defects hid it: getWebServices() cached services on globalThis, so after a hot reload the server kept running old code, and its PasskeyVerificationError class no longer matched the action's instanceof check, so failures escaped as unhandled rejections. Fix: request UV but only require user presence (the passkey is a second factor after Discord sign-in), return passkey outcomes instead of throwing, log every rejection reason, and cache only the database connection process-wide.

bugs.title: Auto Voice Deleted Every Empty Voice Channel in a Join-to-Create Hub's Category, Including Permanent Server Channels
bugs.description: Reported 2026-09-26: AutoVoiceService deleted any empty voice channel in the category of a join-to-create hub, not only the temporary channels it created. Both the member-leave handler and cleanupOrphans (run on READY) matched channels by category, and the set of created channels lived only in memory, so after a restart the bot could not tell its channels from the server's own. A guild with permanent voice channels next to a hub lost them whenever they were empty. Fix: persist the IDs of created channels in a new dual-dialect auto_voice_channels table (AutoVoiceChannelRepository), delete only recorded channels, forget records when the channel is deleted or no longer exists (including the channelDelete gateway event), and make cleanupOrphans iterate the records instead of scanning the category. Existing databases need pnpm db:push.

bugs.title: Reminder Times Were Read in the Host's Time Zone Instead of the User's IANA Zone
bugs.description: Found by the first CircleCI run (UTC host). parseReminderTime passed the IANA zone name to chrono-node, which only understands abbreviations or offset minutes and silently fell back to the host zone, so wall-clock reminders fired hours off on any server not in the user's zone. Now passes the zone's offset in minutes and re-parses with the target date's offset across DST changes.

bugs.title: Message Credits Are Never Awarded Because Anti-Spam Runs Twice per Message
bugs.description: Found in the STORY-115 audit. The message listener evaluates anti-spam (apps/bot/src/listeners/message.listener.ts), which records the message, then EconomyService.handleEvent evaluates it again without the message content (packages/services/src/economy/economy.service.ts). The second check fails on minimum length and the cooldown, so MESSAGE_SENT never pays credits.

bugs.title: Legacy Migration Reads the Wrong Karma and Welcomer Keys
bugs.description: Found in the STORY-115 audit. The legacy transformer maps karma.enabled and welcomer.channel, but 1.4.0 stored karma-notification-enabled (enabled/disabled) and welcomer_channel. The item seed part (slug IDs on a uuid column on Postgres, categories without rows) moved to TASK-1653 in STORY-165 on 2026-09-27.

bugs.title: Achievement Progress Is Recorded Only for TUTORIAL_CLEARED
bugs.description: Found in TASK-1125. AchievementService.recordProgress is only called by the tutorial (TUTORIAL_CLEARED). The seeded CARD_COUNT, ELEMENTAL_COUNT, MYTHIC_CARD_COUNT, PVP_WINS, DUNGEON_FLOOR, BOSS_DAMAGE, EQUIPMENT_ENHANCE_10 and DAILY_STREAK achievements can never unlock. Record progress at each source, then add the types to TRACKED_ACHIEVEMENT_TYPES in @ririko/core so the owner console and guild inspector stop flagging them.

bugs.title: Canonical Game Item Seed Used Dynamic UUIDs Breaking Inventory Foreign Keys on Schema Recreation
bugs.description: When drizzle-kit push recreated the game_items table in SQLite, syncCanonicalItems generated new random UUIDs for all canonical items. Meanwhile, user_inventory_items retained their existing pre-push UUIDs, causing all player gear lookups to fail and rendering card loadouts and inventories empty. Fix: pin static deterministic UUIDs in CANONICAL_ITEM_IDS in packages/services/src/waifu-tcg/equipment/catalog.ts, pass them to itemRepo.create(), and author scripts/recover-player-gears.ts which mapped and restored all 70 orphaned player inventory items in data/ririko.sqlite with 0 data loss.

bugs.title: Count Every Stamina Potion in Multi-Quantity Uses
bugs.description: Bulk stamina potion use restores all requested energy but counts one daily use. Enforce remaining allowance for the entire batch and increment by quantity.

bugs.title: Card Album Inlined Every Card Render as a Base64 Data URL, Producing a Multi-Megabyte Page That Blocked First Paint
bugs.description: CardAlbumService drew all 24 cards of a page before the HTML was sent and returned each 800x1200 PNG as a data: URL, so the album HTML (and the RSC payload, which repeats every src) carried tens of megabytes of base64. next start logged "This rendered a large document (>512 kB) without any Suspense boundaries". Fix: the page lists cards only, and each loads its render from an owner-only GET route handler that reads the CardImageService cache (public/cards/.png).

bugs.title: Bot Fell Back to sqlite:storage/ririko.db Without DATABASE_URL Instead of the ./data/ririko.sqlite Every Other Entry Point Uses

codegraph_queries: createBotServices DATABASE_URL fallback createDatabaseClient AppConfigSchema DATABASE_URL default runDoctorChecks database check

acceptance: @ririko/core exports DEFAULT_DATABASE_URL (./data/ririko.sqlite) and AppConfigSchema uses it as the DATABASE_URL default.

@ririko/database exports databaseConfigFromEnv(env = process.env), returning { dialect: DATABASE_DIALECT or sqlite, url: DATABASE_URL or DEFAULT_DATABASE_URL }, with unit tests for the defaults and for set values.

createBotServices, the four CLI database commands, the doctor database check and the five scripts build their database config with databaseConfigFromEnv; no copy of the DATABASE_URL or DATABASE_DIALECT fallback is left outside it.
Without DATABASE_URL, the bot opens ./data/ririko.sqlite, the same file as the dashboard and CLI.
bugs.verify_cmd: pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm vitest run packages/database/src/client packages/core/src/config apps/cli/src && pnpm lint --quiet
bugs.description: Found while building the bot image (TASK-1212). createBotServices fell back to sqlite:storage/ririko.db when DATABASE_URL was unset. resolveDatabasePath passes sqlite: URLs through unresolved, so better-sqlite3 opened a file named "sqlite:storage/ririko.db" relative to the working directory, while the config schema, the dashboard, the CLI, the scripts and .env.example all default to ./data/ririko.sqlite. A bot started without DATABASE_URL therefore used a different, empty database from the dashboard. Fix: one databaseConfigFromEnv helper in @ririko/database, with the default URL defined once in @ririko/core.
